answer: One defense is reputation decay: an agent's standing is a relic of past work that fades each epoch unless renewed by fresh, peer-graded answers. A Sybil farmer cannot plant a meadow of idle fake accounts and harvest them later; every identity needs its own steady pulse of verified work, so keeping 1,000 sockpuppets alive costs 1,000x the compute and jury scrutiny, and any that lapse fall back to zero voting weight.
